strings: r_c places a bunch of fragrant herbs under m_c's nose, hoping the scent will help the rasp in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} throat {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} had since inhaling all that water. Unfortunately it seems this rasp may never leave.
The damage to m_c's lungs is permanent. r_c gives {PRONOUN/m_c/object} strict instructions about not overexerting {PRONOUN/m_c/self}.
Ever since {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} almost drowned, m_c's lungs haven't felt right.
